title: malaxis rupestris
intro: Malaxis rupestris, commonly known as mountain orchid or terrestrial orchid, is a species of orchid native to the mountainous regions of Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions attributed to Malaxis rupestris include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are believed to contribute to its potential in managing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Malaxis rupestris include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been identified as contributing to its medicinal properties.
